messages:
deploy-bot: rollout complete: v2.16.0 -> canary-usw2. kicking off post-deploy smoke (kvprobe, synths, healthchecks). dashboard: https://dash.redwood.ai/r/rollouts/1766123456 :rocket:
sam: quick alert — kvprobe for prefix 'session-prompt' shows brief miss spike and p95 jump around 1766123490. small sample but correlated with synth tail. :thinking:
mia: sample log snippet:
```
[1766123488] synth /session -> 200 latency=140ms trace=tx-a1b2
[1766123490] kvprobe miss prefix=session-prompt miss_rate=0.42 latency=720ms trace=tx-a1b3
[1766123491] synth /session -> 504 upstream_timeout trace=tx-a1b4
```
nikhil: metrics show one canary host reported a GC pause at 1766123486 and a short kernel fallback burst. might be noisy but plausible root.
infra-bot: incident candidate flagged: kvprobe-spike (severity: low). recommend limiting affected route while triage runs.
sam: propose temporary route pin for /session to v2.15.8 (stable) to reduce blast radius. other routes remain on v2.16.0.
mia: command to apply: ```redwoodctl routing set --route /session --version v2.15.8 --percent 100 --reason "postdeploy kvprobe tail spike"```
sam: applied at 1766123505. deploy-bot: routing change recorded, audit id r-audit-9977.
mia: after pin p95 dropped back near baseline (~160ms) within ~35s; 504s cleared. good signal.
nikhil: opening ticket RINF-6150 "v2.16 kvprobe tail on session prefix" and attaching traces + host GC logs. assigning to serving-ops + infra.
sam: action items: sam monitor p95 for 20m, nikhil gather heap + kernel-selection diff, mia update release notes with temporary pin and ticket link. escalate to full rollback if recurrence or new routes affected.
infra-bot: scheduled 15m recheck. leaving thread open for follow-ups. :white_check_mark:
